jobs.title: Senior Project Manager BESS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 500 Mitarbeitenden an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland. Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen. 
 Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.
 
 Aufgaben, die motivieren: 
 Projektmanagement von BESS-Projekten (Battery Energy Storage Systems) mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Markt

 Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

 Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

 Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

 Koordination von Nachunternehmern sowie Sicherstellung von QA/QC (Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle)

 Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei der Akquise neuer Projekte

 
 Qualifikationen, die überzeugen: 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

 6–8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektrotechnischer Anlagen in Deutschland

 Erfahrung in der Planung von Anlagen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) oder anderen elektrotechnischen Anlagen in Deutschland

 Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau

 Reisebreitschaft

 Sympathische Unternehmenskultur und gelebte V I e LF alt: Viele lokale aber auch überregionale Live-Events prägen unser Miteinander und der Großteil der Mitarbeitenden ist per "Du". Besonders stolz macht uns die Internationalität unseres Teams mit mehr als 30 unterschiedlichen Nationen.

 Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: An allen Standorten sind unsere Arbeitsplätze technisch hochwertig und mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet. Auch wenn es uns von anderen Unternehmen vielleicht nicht unterscheidet: Wir bieten freie Getränke, den obligatorischen Obstkorb und weitere Snacks für Zwischendurch inklusive Eis im Sommer.

Unsere Nachwuchskräfte treffen sich regelmäßig im Club der Jungingenieur:innen .

 Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

 Background in commercial, retail, or real estate development environments (e.g., flexible office, commercial fit-outs, retail spaces).

 Proven experience delivering projects from concept through to operational launch.

jobs.title: Product Manager Mission Payload Land (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Join Quantum-Systems and drive mission-critical payload capabilities to make a real impact. As Product Manager Mission Payload Land, you own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery for payload capabilities across our Land Domain Vehicle Portfolio. 
 You operate at the intersection of customer value, technical feasibility, and commercial viability; working in tight collaboration with payload providers and internal engineering teams. You balance tactical mission requirements against platform constraints, make build-or-buy trade-offs consciously, and define high-value ConOps and payload configurations that the organization can execute against. 
 
 What is your Day to Day Mission: 
 
 End-to-End Product Management: Own the vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management for mission payload integration across the UGV portfolio from discovery and concept validation to operational deployment 

 Market Screening & Ecosystem Management: Screen the market to identify, evaluate, and stand up partnerships with payload vendors across the domains ISR, Electronic Warfare, Communications, Combat Engineering, Logistics, and more 

 Continuous Discovery & Experimentation: Drive prototyping and experimental integration of partner payloads including mechanical, E/E, and software integration interfaces and assess performance and usability 

 Build-or-Buy & Productization: Prioritize payload capabilities based on mission utility and drive formal build-or-buy decisions for high-value use cases 

 Engineering & Vendor Collaboration: Serve as the functional bridge between external payload suppliers, customer stakeholders, and internal engineering teams 

 Iterative Delivery: Consolidate customer, user, and field operational insights to set product priorities and continuously convert requirements into shipped capabilities 

 
 
 
 What you bring to the team: 
 Multiple years of hands-on experience in technical product/project management or systems engineering, ideally at a Tier-1 Defence Electronics, C4ISR, or Sensor Subsystem OEM 

 Strong commercial instincts paired with a solid technical foundation, enabling you to liaise seamlessly between engineering teams and external customer stakeholders 

 A proactive, solution-oriented approach with a proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment 

 Fluency in English to effectively engage with our global team and international customers; German is a plus 

 
 

 Why Quantum-Systems: 
 We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

 We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. 

 We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

 We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

 
 
 Our benefits: 
 Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

 Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

 Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

 Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

 

 La practice RetailTech regroupe nos clients du retail et de l'e-commerce : des acteurs qui transforment l'expérience d'achat de millions d'utilisateurs, en magasin comme en ligne. Elle rassemble les équipes produit, tech et design qui les accompagnent au quotidien sur des programmes à fort enjeu business. 

 

 C'est un domaine en pleine structuration : on y construit la communauté produit, on outille le staffing, on anime les rituels collectifs (all-hands, dojos) et on contribue aux avant-ventes pour faire grandie le portefeuille. 
 

 Tes futures missions : 

 En tant que Product Manager , ton rôle est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité, au service de la satisfaction client. 

 

 - Prioriser et livrer des fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée , en respectant les jalons et les engagements pris auprès du client. 

 - Montrer la valeur et l’avancement de l’équipe en rendant le travail visible et en facilitant les décisions du client (review decks, daily mails,…). 

 - Comprendre les préférences du client et organiser une réaction rapide et adaptée en cas de problème, en s’appuyant sur des outils comme le modèle de valeur, les questionnaires clients et les résolutions de problème. 

 - Piloter le delivery au quotidien en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : gestion du backlog, rédaction de user stories claires et planification des sprints. 

 - Collaborer étroitement avec le client pour comprendre ses besoins, faciliter ses décisions et co-construire les solutions. 

 - Traduire les enjeux produit en exigences claires pour l’équipe technique , en t’appuyant sur l’analyse des usages, l’étude de l’environnement et les benchmarks. 

 - Aider l’équipe à tenir ses engagements en anticipant les risques, en résolvant les problèmes et en contribuant aux routines d’amélioration continue (résolution de problèmes, rétrospectives). 

 

 Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : 

 - iDealwine® : leader mondial des enchères de vins en ligne a engagé la migration de son site e-commerce monolithique vers une architecture composable pour gagner en évolutivité, en sécurité et en maîtrise technologique. Après 2 mois de cadrage, les équipes Theodo ont piloté une approche design-to-cost permettant de modulariser la plateforme et de migrer 20 ans d’historique en 14 mois, dans le respect du budget et du planning. 

 

 - Sevetys : refonte complète d’une web app métier avec deux volets stratégiques : un outil de prise de rendez-vous pour les propriétaires d’animaux et un back-office dédié aux vétérinaires . Deux équipes produit ont piloté la reconstruction des plateformes de bout en bout, rejointes en fin de projet par une équipe data pour structurer et valoriser les données. Principal défi : une mise en production coordonnée à grande échelle , impliquant de nombreuses cliniques vétérinaires, sans interruption d’activité. 

 

 Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : 

 Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . 

 

 Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. 

 

 Profil recherché : 

 - Diplômé·e d’une grande école d’ingénieur , entre 2 et 5 ans d’expérience, idéalement en conseil ou dans un contexte avec forte exposition client. 

 - Intérêt marqué pour la conception de produits à fort impact business , avec une appétence pour la tech et de bonnes connaissances sur le sujet. 

 - Excellente aisance relationnelle : à l’aise face aux clients, capable d’adopter la bonne posture et de créer une relation de confiance. 

 - Posture client first : disponible, réactif, à l’écoute, capable de prioriser le client, d’intégrer les retours et d’anticiper les besoins. 

 - Forte envie d’apprendre et de progresser , capable de challenger son équipe, de demander de l’aide et d’accepter d’être challengé.

jobs.title: Technology Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role 
 We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.
 This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market .
 You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.
 Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows , helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.
 This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.
 
 What you will do 
 Technology & Product Narrative 
 Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

 Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

 Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

 Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

 Messaging & Positioning Framework 
 Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

 Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

 Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

 Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

 Content Strategy & Creation

jobs.title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.
  • Je begrijpt hoe platformen als Face

jobs.title: Head of Product Experience
jobs.description:
At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.
 
 As one of the world's fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of travelers find and book the right stay at the right price. They can book with us directly, compare offers across 100+ booking sites, or book through partners who offer our experience under their own brand.
 
 Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.
 
 With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.
 
 🔍 Who we're looking for 
 We're looking for a senior design leader to own Vio's whole user experience: Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and the product outcomes they serve. You'll lead a team of around ten across design, research and content. This is a chance to build a function, not inherit one.
 You'll report to our Head of Product and sit in domain leadership alongside product, engineering and commercial leaders, shaping strategy from the start. Vio runs two businesses on one platform: our consumer product, and white-label and API products for partners. Your job is to make the experience across both recognisably world-class, and to build a team that can sustain it.
 
 ☑️ What you'll do 
 Set the UX vision for Vio's next chapter, and bring product, engineering and commercial partners along with it.

 Own user-facing outcomes with your peers, and make design's contribution measurable.

 Lead Product Design, UX Research and Content Design, and design the org that brings them together in your first 90 days.

 Set and hold the craft bar: run critique and product reviews, and make journeys consistent across our products and brands.

 Work with Product and Engineering on how we ship, not only what we ship: bring design into problem framing early, and raise the quality of what reaches our users.

 Build a team people want to join and stay in: clear ownership, air cover, real growth paths, and recognition for great work.

 Stay close to the work, with ring-fenced time on north-star concepts and cross-product journeys.

 Make AI part of how design, research and content work.

 Give design a stronger voice inside Vio and a visible presence outside it.

 
 🔎 Who you are 
 You've led a multi-discipline UX organisation (design and design systems, research, content) at scale, including leaders of leaders, with real depth across all three, including research.

 You frame the problem before the solution, make trade-offs between user and commercial needs, and can show the outcomes and metrics you've moved with Product.

 You're a credible peer to senior product, engineering and business leaders, and you influence beyond design.

 You've designed B2B2C products, where partners offer the product to their own customers and judge it as well as end users.

 Your own craft holds up at the highest level: you lead critique, set the quality bar in the details, and articulate a vision that others rally behind.

 You build teams that grow, and you hire people stronger than yourself.

 You use AI in your own practice and know how to scale it across a team.

 Nice to have: travel, marketplace or OTA experience; multi-brand or white-label design systems; a visible external profile through talks, writing or case studies. 
 
 ❓ Why join us now? 
 You'll build Vio's design function and shape its UX from a seat in domain leadership, at a pivotal moment for the company.

 We're one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year.

 In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK, establishing Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

 Our mobile apps ( iOS and Android ) have reached 5 million installs with strong customer reviews.

 We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

 
 ➕ What we offer 
 Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

 A great compensation package, perks, and benefits - including significant stock appreciation rights.

 Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

 You'll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam.

 We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

 We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

 A budget for your home office.

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager – Legal AI Scaleup
jobs.description:
Du entscheidest, was wir bauen und über 450 Kanzleien täglich nutzen. 
 Als Product Manager:in bist du die zentrale Stimme dafür, wohin sich unser KI-Associate entwickelt. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, sprichst täglich mit Kanzleien und baust Prototypen selbst, statt sie nur zu beschreiben. Du prägst entscheidend, wie sich Silvernova strategisch und produktseitig weiterentwickelt.
 Über uns: Silvernova entwickelt den ersten digitalen Mitarbeiter für Anwaltskanzleien – die führende Lösung für komplexe Mandate. VC-finanziert und Investoren von Top-Kanzleien an Bord. Über 450 Anwaltskanzleien nutzen den KI-Associate täglich – damit sind wir eines der am schnellsten wachsenden LegalTech-Scaleups Deutschlands: Du baust daran von Anfang an mit.
 Deine Aufgaben
 Produktstrategie & Roadmap – Du entwickelst die Produktvision für die nächsten Jahre, priorisierst die Roadmap und arbeitest Features bis zur Umsetzungsreife aus.

 Prototyping – Du baust ausgereifte Prototypen und neue Agenten-Fähigkeiten selbst mit AI-Tools und validierst sie mit Kunden, bevor Entwicklungszeit fließt.

 Kundennähe – Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit unseren Kanzleien, verstehst ihre Arbeitsabläufe im Detail, erkennst, wo der Schuh drückt, und bringst das zurück ins Produkt.

 Sparring mit Engineering – Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Entwickler:innen während der Umsetzung: Anforderungen schärfen, Trade-offs entscheiden, Qualität abnehmen.

 Release-Kommunikation – Wir releasen jede Woche. Du sorgst dafür, dass Customer Success, Sales und unsere Kunden wissen, was neu ist – über Release Notes, unsere Product-Academy und Webinare.

 Was du mitbringst
 Einer von zwei Wegen – Entweder mehrere Jahre Produktmanagement in einem SaaS-Scaleup oder Erfahrung als Anwält:in mit nachweisbarer Produkt- und KI-Affinität. Wer beide Welten kennt, ist unser Idealfall – Voraussetzung ist es nicht.

 AI-native – Du hast selbst schon Anwendungen gebaut (z.B. Vibecoding) und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du verstehst, was agentische Systeme heute können – und was (noch) nicht.

 Gespür für Design & UI – Du hast ein genaues Auge für Details und weißt, wann ein Feature wirklich fertig ist und wann nicht.

 Unternehmerisches Denken – Du hast eine eigene, begründete Meinung dazu, wohin sich Legal AI entwickelt, und denkst in Markt und Wirkung, nicht nur in Features.

 Kommunikationsstärke – Du trittst gegenüber Kanzleien souverän auf, formulierst gegenüber Engineering präzise und schreibst verständlich. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mindestens C1.

jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting stay stable and easy to extend.
  • Grow Raisin’s tax proposition: Shape how tax works when Raisin enters new markets, launches tax-advantaged products or brings on new partners. Find where we can take tax work off customers’ hands, so they don’t have to declare and settle it themselves.
  • Turn complex rules into simple experiences: Translate the  tax rules behind each launch into clear requirements with the edge cases covered. Design the customer experience and see the work through to delivery.
  • Hit the deadlines that cannot move: Make sure annual tax documents and statutory reports go out correct and on time, working with Product Operations. Plan backwards from fixed dates and monitor data quality.
  • Catch errors before they reach customers, and escalate early when a date is at risk.
  • Make tax effortless for customers: Keep self-service for tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates intuitive, so customers get them right the first time. Give Customer Service the tools to answer tax questions fast, especially around tax season.
  • Shape the team culture: Give and ask for feedback openly, share wins with the team, and treat mistakes as a reason to fix the process.

Your Profile

Must haves:

  • 3+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical product such as a back-end, platform or data-heavy service.
  • Experience leading a cross-functional product team and getting engineers and stakeholders behind shared priorities.
  • Experience launching new products or taking products into new markets, with the precision to get every edge case right, because one wrong tax rule can affect thousands of customers.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone
 Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.
 At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.
 I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.
 Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.
 That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it.
 You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.
 — Grigory
 
Why Secfix exists
 Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.
 Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.
 We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.
 This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.
 
What you'll actually do in the first 3 months
 This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:
 Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. By the end of the month, the team should be bringing you their hardest technical questions — because you've earned it, not because of the title.
 Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start pairing and doing technical 1:1s with two or three engineers, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.
 Month 3: Own technical hiring. Take over the technical interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.
 
What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?
 After the first quarter, the job is the technical decisions — and, as the team grows, management. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — you'll run the technical side of it.
 Most of your time stays in the code: you ship every week and own the specs, architecture, and reviews on our biggest projects. As the team grows, you'll take on 1:1s, growth conversations, and eventually managing the team.
 Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:
 Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

 Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

 Team and hiring. Technical interviews and mentoring now; 1:1s, growth conversations, and the EM role as we

jobs.title: Product Marketing & Growth Manager – 6-month contract (H/F)
jobs.description:
About Pysae
 Pysae is a French SaaS company building real-time fleet supervision (AVM / SAEIV) and workforce management software for public transport operators. Bus networks, coach operators and transport authorities in France and across Europe rely on our platform every day to run their services, inform passengers and manage their drivers. We are a team of around 40 people based in Rennes, Paris and Italy, and we are expanding fast internationally.
 Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth.
 The role
 Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own product marketing and growth: generating demand through the product itself and by showcasing the value of the Pysae platform.
 This is an international role. You will work on France, Italy and our new markets across Europe and beyond, with sales teams and customers in several countries and languages.
 This is not a classic marketing job. Our market (public transport operators and authorities) has long been sold to in the same way: tenders, trade shows and long sales cycles. We want to break that pattern. Your mission is to invent, test and deploy new ways of selling and growing , using the product, content, data and AI as levers. You will have a blank page, direct access to the CRO and the founders, and the freedom to try things that have never been done in our industry.
 It is a very exciting position, and a demanding one: you will need to come up with ideas, prove quickly whether they work, drop what doesn't and scale what does.
 Your missions
 Invent new sales & growth methods 
 Imagine new ways to reach, engage and convert transport operators and authorities, beyond the traditional tender-driven playbook

 Design and run fast experiments (new channels, formats, offers, outreach sequences, product-led motions), measure the results and turn the winners into repeatable playbooks for the sales team

 Bring fresh ideas from other industries and from the latest AI and growth practices, and adapt them to our market

 Product marketing & positioning 
 Sharpen the positioning and messaging of the Pysae platform and its modules for each segment (urban networks, interurban and school transport, on-demand transport, rail) and each country

 Turn product releases into launches: release notes, feature pages, demo videos, customer-facing announcements

 Build sales enablement material with the sales team, in French and English: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, ROI arguments

 International growth 
 Support our expansion into new countries: market-entry campaigns, localised messaging and content, lead generation for our international sales team

 Design and run product-led growth initiatives: onboarding, in-app messaging, feature adoption, upsell and cross-sell across our customer base

 Create and run campaigns (LinkedIn, email, webinars, international trade shows, content) that generate qualified pipeline for the sales team

 Produce creative content that showcases the platform and our customers: case studies, articles, videos, social posts

 Track and report on what works (traffic, leads, conversion, adoption) and double down on it

 AI & automation 
 Use AI tools intensively to create and translate content, personalise outreach, analyse data and run campaigns at scale

 Automate as many marketing and sales workflows as possible (CRM, emailing, reporting, content production), and document them so they keep running after your contract

 Practical details
 Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract (CDD)

 Location: Paris, Rennes or Florence

 Languages: French and English required

 Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer

 Start date: as soon as possible

 
 Fluent French and English (both required) , written and spoken; Italian or another European language is a plus

 Business or marketing school degree, ideally a Master's (business school or equivalent)

 A first experience (internships included) in product marketing, growth or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in an international environment

 A truly creative mindset: you love inventing new approaches, you are not afraid of a blank page, and you would rather test a bold idea than copy a playbook

 An entrepreneurial, hands-on attitude: you turn ideas into experiments quickly, learn from failures and keep going

 An international mindset: you enjoy working across countries and cultures, and adapting your message to each market

 A strong AI user: you already use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Make/Zapier or similar to work faster, and you are curious about what comes next

 Data-driven: you measure, test and iterate

 Autonomous, organised and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving scale-up

 An interest in mobility, public transport or tech for the public good is a plus

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
jobs.description:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.
  • Work with partnerships and legal. You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. You also give the people negotiating contracts technical findings and cost per call.
  • Manage the teams around you. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.
  • Shape person-focused investigation tools. You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.
  • Measure the integration layer. Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.

About you

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with experience owning a technically complex area end-to-end, such as an integration platform, an API product, or data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable in API documentation. You can discuss OAuth versus API keys, polling versus webhooks, pagination and rate limits with engineers as an equal, and you can try an endpoint yourself in Postman or curl.
  • You have designed admin or configuration interfaces for technical users: connection setup, status and error states, audit trails.
  • You write specs and acceptance criteria that are specific enough to build

 CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

 Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

 Deploy is Akur8’s stateless rating engine, delivering subsecond insurance premium computations across a wide range of industry use cases.
 It sits at the intersection of two key functions in insurance. Actuaries extract insights from data and make the statistical decisions that shape the business. IT teams, in turn, build and maintain the reliable systems that put those decisions into production.
 Today, these two worlds operate with different skills, priorities and tools, connected through slow, manual handoffs between teams.
 
 Deploy replaces this process with a shared foundation that aligns actuarial and IT teams and reduces time-to-market. Building it requires a deep understanding of how both functions are organised, what each is trying to achieve, and the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing. This is what makes the role both dynamic and challenging.
 At Akur8, we value a builder mindset. We embrace the AI revolution by providing the right tools and removing barriers, so that everyone contributing to product development maximises their impact.
 
 We’re looking for a Pricing Engine Product Manager to join the Deploy team, a cross-functional role focused on solving problems and rapid delivery of results to our customers.
 To succeed, you’ll build a solid understanding of how the different parts of our platform interact, allow you to abstract customer problems into a clear framework, turning complex challenges into clean solutions.
 
 We’re interested in people who are motivated by solving problems and comfortable diving deep into the details. You take innovative approaches to find intuitive solutions to seemingly complex problems.
 You also share our builder mindset, and you get excited about delivering fast iterations on difficult challenges.
 
 Main responsibilities 
 Continuously deepening your understanding of actuarial ratemaking and IT deployment challenges, including product models and Policy Admin System design.

 Working at pace, with short iteration cycles, to shape user flows and prototypes that tackle complex API management and distil insurance complexity into clean, opinionated solutions.

 Defining frameworks and approaches that address user pain points, prioritising what matters and setting aside what doesn’t.

 Leading user interviews to build a thorough understanding of end users’ challenges and objectives.

 A Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline

 3+ years experience in either the P&C insurance industry or with products managing, defining and orchestrating high performant API connections and integrations.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 About the role
 Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.
  
 What you'll do
 Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

 Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

 Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

 Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

 Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

 Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

 Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

  
 What you'll bring
 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

 Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

 Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

 A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

 Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

 Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

 Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

  
 What you'll get
 Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

 Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

 Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, AI Agents & Assistant
jobs.description:
About Dashlane

Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Millions of consumers, and over 25,000 brands worldwide, such as Michelin, Air France, and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security, and an unmatched user experience. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.

We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. At Dashlane, we drive innovation and value learning, strive for excellence in everything we do, and thrive as one team. Learn more about life at Dashlane, including how we work, how we hire, and the benefits of being a Dashlaner.

 

About the role

As our Staff Product Manager for Agentic Capabilities, you will own the vision, strategy and roadmap for how Dashlane becomes an interface for AI agents and assistants for consumers and businesses. Success means people hand real, valuable tasks to agents through Dashlane and keep doing it, and companies trust it enough to let their teams do the same.

You will own the product alongside senior engineers as a Staff-level individual contributor in a 0-to-1 role where standards are still unsettled. We are looking for strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, assistants and agentic workflows, and sound judgment about what agents can and cannot be trusted with.

At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the direction. Form and defend a point of view on how agents and assistants should act with what Dashlane protects, for consumers and businesses, and turn it into a strategy, positioning, and multi-year plan that leadership will back.

  • Read the market and judge readiness. Keep a living view of how agent makers, assistants, browsers, identity vendors and password managers are moving. Assess how ready emerging pieces such as passkeys for agents and agent sign-in standards are, and set the triggers for acting on each.

  • Own the evidence. Run discovery on the jobs people hand to agents at home and at work. Establish who hands over real tasks and what holds them back, so your bets follow demand, not hype.

About DeepJudge: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

 DeepJudge is a fast-growing venture-backed startup at the forefront of applying Artificial Intelligence in the legal domain. Founded by ex-Googlers and ETH PhDs, our mission is to help legal teams harness their collective knowledge so they can focus on the strategic aspects of their work. DeepJudge’s state-of-the-art knowledge retrieval system directs legal professionals to the internal insights that matter most, providing a strong foundation for AI-powered workflows. We’re headquartered in Zurich, with a team in the United States and Canada, and cater to clients all around the world.
 We are looking for a thoughtful and strategic Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we communicate the value of AI-powered legal solutions to the market. As a subject matter expert on our products, you will craft compelling messaging, develop go-to-market strategies, and collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure our positioning resonates with customers.
 This is an exciting opportunity for a marketer who is passionate about making complex technology approachable and valuable for legal professionals. You are a great fit for this role if you have a proven track record in B2B SaaS product marketing, a talent for crafting compelling messaging, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to drive product launches, customer adoption, and market success.
 

 What you’ll be doing 
 Craft compelling messaging and positioning that articulates the value of DeepJudge to our core audiences, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

 Lead the launch of new features and products, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful adoption and engagement.

 Translate data and findings into actionable insights that drive decisions and fuel impactful product and feature updates.

 Collaborate with the Marketing team to support marketing campaigns for new product features and updates.

 Use tools such as Hubspot, Figma, Webflow, Linear, and G Suite to manage projects, analyze data, and create content, with a focus on data-driven decision-making

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Taurus 
 Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.
 Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.
 Tasks
 The Role 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.
 This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 Main Responsibilities 
 Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

 Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

 Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

 Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

 Requirements
 Your Profile 
 Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

 Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

 Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

 Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

 Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

 Willingness to travel to client locations as required

 Benefits
 What We Offer 
 An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

 A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

 A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

 A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

 As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.
 Note 
 We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Product Catalogue)
jobs.description:
Make Your Mark as a Senior Product Manager (Product Catalogue) at Storio Group 
 About the role 

Every product we sell, from photo books to calendars to canvases, is defined in our product model and catalogue. It sits under almost everything we do, and we are reshaping it as we move our ecommerce platform towards proven, bought capabilities. You will lead that work. Your customers are internal: the engineers, systems and teams who launch and sell our products every day. This is a platform role with real scope and real complexity, and we will be upfront about both.

 How you embrace curiosity daily 
 

 
 You own the roadmap for our product model, catalogue and platform capabilities, from first idea to measured impact.

 
 You untangle a grown, multi-brand landscape and turn it into something simple and self-service.

 
 You help shape what we buy, what we build and what we retire, with clear numbers behind each call.

 
 You work closely with engineers on trade-offs, and with product operations, marketing and production as true customers.

 
 You push back constructively when a one-off request should be a reusable capability.

 
 You use AI tools in your own workflow and across the product cycle, and you are curious about where they help and where they do not.

 How you make your mark 
 

 
 Teams launch new products faster, with fewer tickets and less manual work.

 
 You build a roadmap that balances platform health, delivery and commercial value.

 
 You bring people along the journey early, so nobody works in isolation.

 
 You turn deep system decisions into outcomes the business can see.

 What you bring to the team 
 

 
 5+ years as a Product Manager, ideally on platform or shared-service products.

 
 Experience with an ecommerce platform migration, ideally buy-led.

 
 Comfort with data models, APIs and integrations, and credibility with engineers.

 
 Strong data skills and a habit of making trade-offs visible with numbers.

 
 A bias for action, clear communication, and ease with ambiguity.

 
 Practical AI fluency: you use AI tools in your own work and know where they help and where they fail.

 What sets you apart 
 

 
 Product catalogue or PIM experience at scale.

 
 Exposure to personalised or configurable products.

 
 Experience evaluating commerce platforms or vendors.

 
 A background in photo, print or creative tools.

 About us 
 At Storio Group, we help people hold onto life's moments. We make personalised photo products that turn fleeting memories into things you can keep, share, and re-live. 
 

 Every person at Storio Group helps create our products and shape our company. You will see the impact of your work daily. We invite you to make your mark on our business, products, and customers' lives. 
 

 We act with heart by putting people first and valuing diverse perspectives. We give our best and aim for high standards in all we do. We own our work, taking initiative to find solutions. We embrace curiosity, always learning and trying new things. We find the joy in our work and create a positive environment. 
 

 Equal Opportunities & Right to Work 
 Storio Group is an equal opportunity employer, celebrating diversity and fostering an inclusive environment. If you require reasonable adjustments during interviews please contact our HR team. 
 

 Applicants must also have the legal right to work in the position's country without requiring sponsorship.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
Why Faculty? 
 
We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .
 
 We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.
 
 Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.
 
 AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.
 
 About the role 
 
 In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.
 Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.
 As a Lead Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on large strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.
 
 What you'll be doing: 
 
 Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

 Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders at big-name clients on their product and AI strategies.

 Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

 Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

 Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

 Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

 Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

 Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

 Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

 Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

 Coaching and developing other product managers.

 
 Who we're looking for: 
 
 You have substantial experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale, including at least 2 years in a product leadership role.

 You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

 Exceptional commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with senior budget holders.

 You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

 You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

 You have demonstrable experience in rolling out cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development processes.

 You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

 You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.

 You're an active voice in the product community, speaking at conferences or contributing to panels and publications.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
V7 
 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). 

 
 The product 
 V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.
 Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.
 Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows .

 Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

 Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation .

 Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance .
 
 The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have 
 You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

 Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

 The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

 It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

 
 What you’ll be doing from day one 
 Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

 Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

 Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

 Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

 Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

 Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

 
 Who you are 
 You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

 You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

 You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

 You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

 You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

 You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

 Opinionated but not precious about it.
 

 V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.
 Compensation: £100K – £140K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
Role summary 
 We are hiring a Product Manager to own a virtual data room’s (VDR), end to end product strategy: roadmap, requirements, release quality and client outcomes.
 You will collaborate with stakeholders, client-facing teams; combining their input with market insight, data and your own judgment to set a clear product direction.
 
 What you will do 
 Strategy and roadmap 
 Own the product vision and roadmap, aligned with TechOps and company goals.

 Track the VDR market, competitors and emerging technology (especially AI), and turn insight into prioritized bets.

 Build business cases with cost, revenue and timeline impact, make clear trade-offs, and explain prioritization and scope changes to stakeholders before they ask.

 Discovery and requirements 
 Run discovery with clients, deal teams, sales and support to understand real workflows and pain points.

 Write features and PBIs in Azure DevOps with clear business rules, scope and testable acceptance criteria.

 Partner with UX design on user-centered solutions for admins, deal managers and external bidders.

 
 Delivery and release 
 Work with product, engineering and QA to plan sprints, unblock work and keep releases moving.

 Be the first point of contact for product questions from engineering, QA and UX.

 Own release readiness, UAT and release notes for every release, including hotfixes.

 Triage escalations and client-reported issues, and agree priorities with Support.

 
 Measurement and clients 
 Define and track product metrics (adoption, time to set up a room, retention, NPS, incident and defect trends), and use product analytics to judge feature performance and guide prioritization.

 Present to key clients and partners, and support sales on high-value deals.

 
 
 What you bring 
 Hands-on virtual data room experience as a product manager, product owner, VDR administrator or heavy deal-side user.

 3+ years as a Product Manager, Product Owner or similar role on B2B SaaS.

 A track record of writing clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can build and test from.

 Experience running agile delivery with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence or similar, including release planning and UAT.

 Working understanding of security and compliance requirements in enterprise software.

 Data-driven decision making, with experience using product analytics to measure what works.

 Strong written and spoken English; you explain technical topics clearly to business stakeholders.

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

 
 Nice to have 
 Background in M&A, investment banking, legal or corporate development.

 Experience shipping AI features such as document classification, search, summarization or automated redaction.

 Experience working in a distributed team across time zones.

 Familiarity with web technologies and APIs.

 Experience with multilingual products or localization.

 Additional languages.

About the Team

Our Trust & Safety, Integrity and Fraud Product team is dedicated to ensuring a safe and trusted experience for all customers across our platform, including Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. We tackle complex challenges, from preventing fraud, abuse and Account Takeover to ensuring authenticity, to building regulatory compliance capabilities, all while balancing risk mitigation and providing a seamless user experience. Our team partners closely with cross-functional groups, including Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Risk Operations, to drive strategic initiatives that protect our business while fostering growth.

About the Role

Trust is foundational to an on-demand marketplace. Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt are converging European capabilities into one platform and one global product capability to prevent fraud and abuse. The marketplace is expanding rapidly beyond just restaurants as we become “your door to more." As we add new products, geographies, ways for Consumers, Merchants and Couriers to engage, we’re expanding and enhancing our fraud capabilities to be best in the industry at keeping our platform safe and trustworthy. We strongly believe that trust is the most important attribute of an online marketplace, and the team ensures that we maintain this trust.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager that will lead dedicated cross-functional teams to solve complex challenges that impact Consumers, Couriers and Merchants and touch every corner of our business - from new user onboarding, to the in-app delivery experience, to the products and services being created that our users can’t find anywhere else. The Fraud team is in hyper growth in terms of its size and impact and offers a unique opportunity to set and execute on a vision that will shape the future of Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt globally.
