  • Prevent, detect and mitigate fraud and abuse, building and leveraging AI systems to address risk in real time.

  • Build an AI-led fraud operations platform that turns complex marketplace signals into automated decisions, prioritised investigations, and actionable case workflows, stopping fraud, abuse and manipulation before incidents occur.

  • Develop and execute a customer-focused product roadmap through close collaboration with senior leadership, Operations, Data Science, Analytics, Design, and Engineering all while balancing business needs.

  • Translate customer and internal-user needs into clear, well-defined functional and technical requirements backed by data analysis and deep understanding of our users

  • Guide and interface closely with data analysis and engineering teams to define scope, review and refine technical capabilities, prioritize projects for release, and define new opportunities.

  • Build long-term instrumentation, monitoring, and evaluation capabilities for product performance, tracking, and to create product insights.

  • Establish business cases and projected return on investment to identify and prioritize opportunities

  • Partner with Finance and Business Leaders to manage the impact on the profitability of the overall business.

  • Establish success metrics and executive reviews covering fraud trends and P&L impact.

 Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: PRODUCT MANAGER

We’re building a new customer platform, including AI Studio and our machine learning products, largely from scratch. These products need one person who owns what gets built, in what order, and why, and who makes sure what ships solves real problems for teams running AI and ML workloads on our GPU infrastructure. You’ll report to our Chief Product & Technology Officer and lead a team of three Product Engineers, based in London or Australia.

jobs.title: Legal Engineer Manager, Product Specialist, Germany
jobs.description:
Why Harvey 
 At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
 This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
 Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
 At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
 
 Role Overview 
 As Harvey scales its post-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager - Product Specialist to lead and grow the Product Specialist team in Munich. This role was created to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Product Specialists who support existing customers in maximising their use of the Harvey platform.
 Harvey’s Legal Engineer - Product Specialists are experienced lawyers from top-tier firms who leverage their legal expertise to help customers seamlessly integrate Harvey into their daily workflows - driving adoption, increasing utilisation, and supporting long-term expansion and renewal. Legal Engineer - Product Specialists collaborate closely with Harvey’s Customer Success Managers to drive all facets of the post-sales strategy. They develop consultative relationships with law firm partners, associates, innovation teams, and in-house counsel, serving as trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can enhance legal effectiveness and efficiency.
 Legal Engineer - Product Specialists draw on their legal training and practice experience to ask thoughtful questions, uncover adoption barriers, and develop tailored strategies that build credibility with customers. They partner with Customer Success Managers to communicate Harvey’s value through a mix of large group sessions, small workshops, and one-on-one conversations.
 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead and develop a team of Legal Engineers - Product Specialists in the DACH region, providing coaching, performance management, and career development support.

 Own the post-implementation customer relationship from a legal engineering perspective, ensuring law firm and in-house clients are effectively onboarded, trained, and supported on an ongoing basis

 Act as the senior escalation point for complex or strategic customer engagements, bringing deep product and legal expertise

 Partner with Account Management and Sales to identify expansion opportunities, support renewals, and contribute to retention strategy

 Collaborate with the Product team to surface customer feedback, advocate for platform improvements, and keep the team informed of new features and roadmap developments

 Define and iterate on team processes, playbooks, and frameworks to build a scalable and high-performing function

 
What You Have 
 Qualified lawyer with 7+ PQE, with experience in a law firm or in-house legal environment

 Prior experience managing or mentoring a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

 Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

 Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

 Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach

jobs.title: Product Development Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About TACTILIA: 
 At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.
 This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the product, roadmap, and development process that make that possible.
 You will join at the moment when the hard robotics questions become real product decisions: how do we turn customer needs into a highly capable robotic hand that is reliable, manufacturable, and ready to deploy on a real shop floor?
 The Role 
 As a Product Development Lead at TACTILIA, you will be the operational backbone of our product development. You will turn customer requirements into a robust roadmap — and the roadmap into a product that reaches the customer on time, on budget and at production quality.
 You will lead through structure, clarity and commitment rather than hierarchy, and report to the CTO. You will work across product development, engineering and customer needs, keeping priorities aligned as TACTILIA moves from development towards production and scale.
 What you will do: 
 Own the product roadmap. Turn customer and market needs into clear product priorities and continuously balance customer value, engineering effort, technical risk, and time-to-market.

 Turn requirements into product decisions. Work with Applications and customers to translate needs into clear, testable specifications, maintaining traceability from RFQ through validation.

 Orchestrate product development. Coordinate Mechatronics, Software, Electronics, Systems Engineering and Applications across milestones, dependencies and interfaces, resolving conflicting priorities when needed.

 Drive the product to production. Own development milestones, gate reviews, budget, unit cost and quality through to production readiness, while helping establish a scalable product development process.

 Make the hard trade-offs. Bring together customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and schedule to make pragmatic decisions and keep development moving.

 Stay close to customers. Support the CTO in technical customer discussions, feasibility assessments, RFQs, trade fairs and partner conversations, bringing market feedback back into the product.

 Build the organisation around the product. Identify gaps in capacity, skills and ownership across engineering, translate them into concrete hiring needs, and make pragmatic make-or-buy decisions.

 Build for the real world. Work with engineering and operations to ensure the product is not only technically capable, but manufacturable, testable, reliable and ready to scale.

 What you bring: 
 A degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a comparable technical field.

 5+ years of experience developing mechatronic or hardware products, including experience in product development or technical project/program management.

 A proven track record taking products from requirements through development to production readiness.

 Strong requirements management and a solid understanding of systems engineering.

 Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary teams without direct line authority.

 Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, cost, quality and time-to-market.

 A hands-on, structured approach and the ability to move between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution.

 Fluent English; German is a strong plus.

 Bonus 
 Experience in robotics, drive technology, gripping technology, or other highly integrated mechatronic systems.

 Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or a corporate spin-off.

 Familiarity with relevant robotics, machinery or functional safety standards.

 The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.
 At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.
 The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.
 That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.
 Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. 
 If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 Running the Engine Behind 200M+ Daily Ad Decisions 

 Behind every ad decision at adjoe is a system designed to operate at massive scale, serving more than 770 million mobile users every year. The Demand API Integrations team owns the systems that connect our platform to the global adtech ecosystem, handling over 5.5 billion API requests daily across installs, events, views, clicks, and postbacks from Mobile Measurement Partners.
We operate a dedicated A/B testing environment against live traffic to validate system behavior under real-world conditions, allowing us to evaluate advertiser integrations, benchmark partner performance, and verify attribution accuracy end-to-end before deploying globally.

We integrate TensorFlow-based ML models to predict user engagement and purchase likelihood, directly influencing real-time ad distribution. To meet our strict 100ms latency constraint, we prioritize efficient model serving, low-latency data access, and deliberate system design.

 
 Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For 
 High-Scale Backend Product Leadership: You will own the roadmap and backlog for the campaign distribution engine that serves over 200 million daily mobile users, balancing rapid business feature requests with long-term platform integrity. We are looking for someone with 5+ years of experience as a Product Lead (preferably in B2B SaaS) managing backend-heavy, high-load systems who can navigate ambiguity and drive product delivery end-to-end.

jobs.description:
Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

 The role 
We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level.
This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

 What you'll own

• Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship.
• The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Models and Data
jobs.description:
About Niantic Spatial
 AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It can't yet reason about real places well enough for robots, field crews and AI agents to rely on it, and closing that gap will change how factories, power grids, cities and defense operations run.
 That's one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it's the one we're solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.
 In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That's why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.
 Our team built some of the world's most widely used maps. Now we're building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.
 
 About the Role
 The Large Geospatial Model is Niantic Spatial's foundation model of the physical world. It learns from years of real-world captures of millions of places, and people, robots and AI agents use it to find out where they are, what is around them and what has changed. Each step up in scale has given the model capabilities it did not have before. The next problems are some of the hardest in AI: filling in the parts of a place no camera saw while marking what was inferred, measuring what changed between visits, and predicting what will change next.
 Customers already use the model in production. Energy companies use it to guide field crews to equipment on large industrial sites, defense partners use it for positioning where GPS is jammed or unavailable, and robotics companies train robots in metric-scale copies of the real sites they will work in.
 You will be the first product leader for the model and the data it learns from, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. You decide which capabilities it gains and in what order, the bar each release has to clear, and what data Niantic Spatial collects, licenses or partners for to get there. You set those priorities directly with the Chief Scientist and the London research team who train the model.
 If you have shipped a frontier language model, most of the job will be familiar: evals, data mix and release decisions. The job differs in two ways. Every output of this model can be scored against a measured real place, so its evals rest on ground truth. And its data is collected in the physical world, so choosing what to capture next is a product decision with a real cost. Experience in 3D or mapping is welcome but not required.
 By the end of your first year, research, engineering and the product leads for industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers work from one model roadmap that you own, each release ships against evals you wrote, and the model's newest capabilities are in customers' hands.
 
 What You'll Do
 Own the Model Roadmap - Decide the order in which the Large Geospatial Model gains its next capabilities, from filling in unseen parts of a site to measuring and predicting change, based on what industrial, defense, robotics and platform customers will pay for. Turn customer problems into specific research requirements, and bring new research results to the product leads who sell into each market.

 Set the Release Bar - Define the evals and acceptance criteria for each capability with the Real-World Test Lab, which measures model output against ground truth in real places. Decide whether each release ships or goes back for more data or training.

 Own the Data Plan - Decide what data Niantic Spatial collects, buys, licenses or gets through partners, and set the product terms of those deals with Legal and Business Development. Set the curation, labeling, consent, privacy and training-rights requirements every dataset has to meet, and keep a record of which data went into each model version.

 Turn Capabilities into Products - Decide when a new model capability is ready to become something customers buy, what it promises them, and how it reaches them through Niantic Spatial's products and platform.

 Set the Long-Term Direction - Decide where the model goes over the next several years, as it moves from describing places as they are to tracking how they change and anticipating what comes next, and make the case for the research and data investment that takes.

 
 What You'll Bring
 8+ years in product management, including at least three years shipping a large model to users or customers.

 Experience writing evals for a model and using them to decide when a release was ready.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
jobs.description:
Introduction 
 Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage. As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.

 What you'll do 
 

 Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.

 Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.

 Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.

 Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.

 Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.

 Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.

 Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.

 Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.

 Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.

 Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.

 Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

 What you'll need 
 

 A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.

 A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.

 Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).

 Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.

 Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.

 Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.

 Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.

 Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.

 What we offer 
 

 A competitive compensation package, of course. 
 

 Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 
 

 Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 
 

 Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
 

 Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 
 

 Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 
 

 Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 
 

 Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die kommerzielle Verantwortung für neue Skincare-Produkte und Beauty Tools, vom Business Case über den Go-to-Market bis zur Performance nach dem Launch. Du verbindest Produkt, Customer Insight und Growth und arbeitest dafür eng mit Head of Product, Product Development, Marketing, E-Commerce und CEO zusammen. Dein Ziel sind nicht möglichst viele Launches, sondern Produkte, die Rosentals nächste Hero Products werden können. Du entwickelst für neue Produkte den kommerziellen Business Case, von Consumer Need und Marktpotenzial über Pricing, Target COGS und Marge bis zum Absatzpotenzial.

 
 Customer Insights, Reviews sowie Markt- und Social-Trends übersetzt du in klare Hero-Product-Konzepte. 

 Den gesamten Go-to-Market-Prozess ownst du. Produkt, Packaging, Claims, Creative, Content, E-Commerce und Marketing greifen zum Launch nahtlos ineinander. 

 Cross-funktionale Launch-Pläne, Critical Paths und Milestones steuerst du so, dass mindestens 90 % aller Milestones fristgerecht erreicht werden. 

 Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Creative entstehen unter deiner Führung Product Stories, Hooks, Claims und Proof Points, die überzeugen und Performance treiben. 

 Mit dem Launch bist du nicht fertig: Die ersten 30/60/90 Tage analysierst du anhand von Umsatz, Conversion, Reviews, Repeat, Marge und Customer Feedback und leitest konkrete Wachstumsmaßnahmen ab. 

 Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Product Management, Go-to-Market, Launch Management oder Growth im Beauty-, Skincare-, Consumer- oder D2C-Umfeld. 

 Mehrere physische Produkte hast du von der Idee bis zum Marktlaunch begleitet und kannst erklären, warum sie kommerziell funktioniert haben. 

 Consumer- und Product-Taste verbindest du mit solidem Verständnis für Pricing, Marge, Business Cases und Wachstum. 

 Komplexe cross-funktionale Projekte zu führen, Prioritäten zu setzen und Teams auf ein gemeinsames Ziel auszurichten, ist deine Stärke. 

 Du arbeitest hands-on, schnell und mit hoher Ownership und wartest nicht auf den nächsten Schritt von anderen. 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1) und sehr gutes Englisch setzen wir voraus.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.description:
The role

From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the operating model: Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production). 
  • Design and scale standards: Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.
  • Lead cross-market change: Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.
  • Lead programs and automation: Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams. 
  • Lead under uncertainty: Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus
  • Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.
  • Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.
  • A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.
  • Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment. 
  • Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus. 

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • 2 years contract.
  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Endear - Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our Story 
 At Endear, we’re building the first modern CRM for retail teams, starting with the frontline.
 
 Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.
 
 We work with brands like Gorjana, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.
 
 Position Overview 
 We're looking for a Product Manager to help shape and deliver the next generation of Endear's platform.
 
 You'll take ownership of product decisions, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with Design, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to turn customer needs and business opportunities into impactful product experiences.
 
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who can operate autonomously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll have meaningful ownership over what gets built, why it matters, and how we measure success, while partnering with product leadership on broader vision and direction.
 
 AI fluency is central to how we work. You'll use AI to accelerate discovery, bring ideas to life through prototyping, automate workflows, and help the team deliver value faster.
 
 This role is well suited for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of decisions, and knows how to connect great product experiences to meaningful business impact.
 
 What You'll Accomplish 
 In your first 6 months, you'll… 
 Take ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch, making decisions around scope, priorities, and tradeoffs.

 Build a deep understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the business problems we're solving.

 Partner closely with Sales, Customer Experience, and Marketing to gather insights, align priorities, and identify opportunities for product improvement.

 Translate customer needs, business goals, and product data into clear priorities and actionable plans.

 Work closely with Design and Engineering to evaluate solutions, make product decisions, and deliver high-quality experiences.

 Define success metrics and take accountability for the customer and business outcomes of the features you ship.

 Use AI to improve how product work gets done, including rapid prototyping, documentation, research synthesis, and workflow automation.

 
 In your first year, you'll… 
 Independently own meaningful areas of the product roadmap, driving decisions and measurable outcomes within the broader product strategy.

 Deliver product improvements that increase adoption, engagement, customer value, and business performance.

 Establish strong feedback loops across customers, Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to inform ongoing product decisions.

 Build repeatable, AI-powered workflows that help the product team operate more efficiently and ship faster.

 Become a trusted cross-functional partner who brings clarity to complex problems and drives alignment around priorities and decisions.

 Demonstrate clear business impact through the products you build and the improvements you deliver.

 
 You'll Thrive in This Role If… 
 You love owning product decisions and are comfortable being accountable for outcomes, not just execution.

 You're able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and make sound decisions without needing constant direction.

 You think commercially and understand how product decisions connect to customer value, adoption, retention, and business growth.

 You naturally bring together different perspectives from Sales, CX, Marketing, Design, and Engineering to make better product decisions.

 You're comfortable challenging assumptions, prioritizing competing needs, and communicating tradeoffs clearly.

 You're highly fluent in AI and actively look for opportunities to automate work, build prototypes, and improve how teams operate.

 You move quickly, experiment often, and know when to gather more information versus when to make a decision.

 You care deeply about understanding customers and solving the right problems.

 
 You Have Experience With

jobs.description:
About Legal 500 
 
 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.
 
 Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.
 
 We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.
 
 About the Role 
 
 Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works. You'll use our enterprise AI tools, with Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft 365 AI capability as the main platform. You'll recommend what should be built or adopted and why, put governance in place where none yet exists, and make sure people across the business use the tools well.
 This is a business-facing product role that starts from how the business works, not a technical build role. Copilot is the primary tool of choice, but you'll also oversee the other AI tools the business adopts.
 
 
 What you'll do 
 You'll sit centrally within our People & Business Operations function, reporting to the Director of People & Business Operations. Your remit covers the whole of Legal 500, not a single department. You'll:
 Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

 Start every opportunity from the end-to-end business process. You'll walk business owners through how work gets done today, often where no SOPs exist, map the pain points, coach them through mapping a future-state process, and find where Copilot, other AI tools or workflow changes will make a measurable difference.

 Personally configure, test and refine Copilot skills, agents and team workflows. You'll take ideas through proof of concept and pilot, then hand ownership of the output to the business owner.

 Design, implement and enforce AI governance from the ground up. This includes owning the intake and review process for new use cases, agents and workflows, working alongside our Data Protection Officer, Information Security and IT Operations

 Own our enterprise AI libraries: the register of approved tools and the libraries of approved agents, prompts, templates and shared workflows. You'll keep them curated, current and compliant, and avoid duplication between tools.

 Design and deliver upskilling yourself, including training sessions, guides, clinics and self-serve resources. You'll also lead AI working groups and champion networks.

 Spot common patterns across teams and bring them together on shared processes and solutions, so the same problem isn't solved many times.

 Define and track adoption and value, such as usage, time saved, quality and user confidence. You'll maintain an AI benefits register, report progress to senior stakeholders and feed role impact into workforce planning.

 
 
 What we're looking for 
 Essential 
 A process-led consulting approach, with a structured way of walking business owners through end-to-end processes, including where no SOPs existed

 Proven experience of setting up AI governance from scratch and enforcing it. This includes owning an intake and review process and working with specialists such as a Data Protection Officer and IT Operations

 Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

 Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

 Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

 Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

 
 Desirable 
 A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

 A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

 An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.
 
 The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.

 
 Make day-one success the default
 Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

 Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

 Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..

 
 Build and run provider partnerships
 Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

 Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

 Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

 Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.

 
 Shape the enterprise AI gateway
 Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

 Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

 Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

 Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

 Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.

 
 Lead across teams
 Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

 Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

 Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves 
 Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

 Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

 A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

 Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

 Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 

 
 Nice-to-haves 
 You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

 Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.

 You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay 
 DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
 Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
 
 Warum es diese Rolle gibt 
 DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
 Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
 
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
 
 Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
 
 Was du konkret machst 
 Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

 OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

 Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

 Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

 User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

 Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

 Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

 Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

 
 Das brauchst du 
 Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

 Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

 Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

 Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

 Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

 Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

 
 Das fällt positiv auf 
 Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

 Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

 Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

 Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

 Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

 Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

 Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von U

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. 

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development
  • 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams
  • You're highly technical, enough to solve almost any problem your team has yourself, but you prefer to guide your team into solving them.
  • Ability to work independently. You’ll be working with stakeholders that are mostly based in North America. You need to be able to make decisions and solve problems autonomously.
  • Excellent communication skills. You must be able to collaborate effectively with teams in a fully-remote environment and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Benefits:

  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
  • 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan
  • Income Replacement Programs
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager D365 CRM
jobs.description:
Digitale transformatie is pas echt succesvol wanneer strategie, technologie en mensen samenkomen. Als Senior Projectmanager bij HSO leid jij CRM-implementaties die organisaties helpen beter met hun klanten te werken. Je werkt met de nieuwste Microsoft Cloud-technologie en stuurt teams aan in uitdagende projecten. Daarbij combineer je overzicht, leiderschap en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Zo maak jij het verschil tussen een systeem implementeren en echte businessimpact realiseren

Taken
- Als Senior Projectmanager leid je Dynamics 365 CRM-implementaties bij onze klanten van start tot succesvolle livegang. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de voortgang, kwaliteit, scope en het budget van je projecten, en zorgt dat teams en stakeholders steeds dezelfde koers varen.
- Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Samen met de klant vertaal je strategische doelen naar een duidelijke projectaanpak en een haalbare roadmap. Je begeleidt workshops, structureert requirements en zorgt dat CRM-processen zoals sales, marketing en service effectief worden ondersteund door Dynamics 365.
- Binnen het project stuur je een multidisciplinair team van (business) consultants, developers en solution architects aan. Je houdt overzicht over planning en afhankelijkheden, stuurt actief op risico’s en zorgt dat beslissingen tijdig worden genomen. Daarbij weet je complexe trajecten te structureren en verwachtingen van stakeholders op verschillende niveaus te managen.
- Onze projecten maken vaak deel uit van bredere Microsoft Cloud-transformaties, waarbij oplossingen zoals Dynamics 365 CRM, Field Service en Power BI samenkomen. In deze omgeving zorg jij voor structuur, richting en resultaat – en help je klanten niet alleen een systeem te implementeren, maar hun manier van werken daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Vereisten
- Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met CRM-implementaties als Projectmanager - dit is essentieel!
- Je deelt onze mindset: kritisch denken, ondernemend zijn en resultaatgericht werken.
- Uitstekende beheersing van het Engels voor internationale projecten.
- Jouw managementvaardigheden zijn consultatief, anticiperend en inspirerend, waardoor het team effectief functioneert.
- Ervaring met het Microsoft-platform, met name Dynamics 365 CRM, is een pre.
- Aantoonbare kennis van projectmanagementmethodieken, zoals PRINCE2, PMI of IPMA C/D-certificering.

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden:
- Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;   
- 25 Vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;   
- Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal); 
- EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;   
- Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;   
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.   

Ben jij klaar om grootschalige Microsoft-applicatieprojecten te leiden? Sluit je aan bij ons team als Senior Projectmanager D365 CRM.
Neem contact op met onze recruit Joseph #LD-JY1

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role 
 We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally.
 
 About DataSnipper 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.
 Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Competitive Intelligence
 Own competitive intelligence end-to-end: track competitors, draft the insight, and turn it into positioning.

 Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling, and playbooks for Sales and Marketing.

 Partner closely with Sales and Product leadership to ensure content is used, measurable, and effective.

 Set up a feedback loop between Sales, Marketing, and Product, and bring market input into roadmap discussions.

 Buyer Personas
 Create and maintain buyer personas for our key audiences.

 Ground them in customer research, win-loss, and sales input. Keep them current.

 Work with Sales to sharpen ICP and qualification criteria.

 Messaging
 Evolve product positioning, value propositions, and messaging that set us apart from competitors.

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value.

 Keep messaging consistent across web, content, campaigns, and sales.
 

 What Success Looks Like 
 Sales teams are fully equipped with enablement content they actually use.

 Product messaging is consistent and clearly different from competitors.

 Personas and messaging reflect what we hear in the market.

 DataSnipper’s value proposition becomes easier to understand, harder to compete with, and stronger across all channels.
 

 What You Bring 
 6–8 years of B2B SaaS Product Marketing, ideally within a scale-up.

 Proven competitive intelligence and positioning work that helped win deals.

 Experience building battlecards and sales content that teams use.

 Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear customer value stories and compelling narratives.

 Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a sharp eye for storytelling, structure, and clarity.

 Nice to have: audit, finance, or other regulated-industry buyers.
 

 What We Offer 
 Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

 Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

 Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

 Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

 Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

 NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

 Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

 Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

 Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

 Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

  
 Recruitment Process 
 Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

 Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes, online)

 Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

 Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

  
 At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 
 Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded
